title: Corporate action master (CDSL, CA_EXP)
purpose: Corporate actions set up at CDSL: type, debit (parent) and credit ISIN, ratio, record and execution dates, dividend per security and status.
linked: Stored as CDSL's corporate action list and shown with corporate actions; actions on ISINs clients hold go to the work queue to be set up
